_notes: Naming per docs/lore/os-lineages.md's 'Product and shell names' table (settled 2026-09-05): BeltOS is the category, Scrapshell is the flagship product within it (same relationship as Linux to Ubuntu), and the shell binary itself is `sash` -- eroded from 'Scrapshell sh' over decades of hand-patched use, same folk-erosion mechanic as /etc -> 'Everyone's To-Change'. lineage_label stays product-level for the prompt display (a real bash prompt doesn't announce 'Linux' either); os_category/product/shell are structured fields for tooling (probe, etc.) to read precisely instead of parsing the display string. editor_name (`scredit`, locked 2026-09-05) is the same idea applied to docs/systems/text-editor.md section 3: one shared, identically-behaving nano-shaped editor core everywhere, only the command name/ownership story differs per lineage -- 'scredit' is BRA-descended techs' free rebuild of the OPRA-era drafting suite after losing licensed access, folk-contracted from 'Screed Editor' the same way 'sash' contracted from 'Scrapshell sh'. See text-editor.md section 3 for the full succession story.

scrapper.profile._notes: Belter-flavored config file, renamed from consolerc+aliases 2026-09-05 per Dan's steer: leans into the scrapper/salvage ethos in the naming itself, the way real dotfiles are named for their shell (.bashrc) but Scrapshell's culture would name its own something with more personality -- same instinct as /etc -> 'Everyone's To-Change' (folk-etymology, not official). One combined file (ls colors, glove-safe chrome accent, aliases) rather than splitting bashrc-equivalent from profile-equivalent the way real Unix does -- Scrapshell never had the coordination to keep those cleanly separate either (os-lineages.md section 0/5's whole argument). Real editable content, not hardcoded GDScript -- Dan's 'bashrc for this machine' idea, 2026-09-04; no in-game text editor exists yet to edit it live, this sets up the mechanism that would hook into.
scrapper.profile.content:
COLOR_DIR=#5c9cff
COLOR_SYMLINK=#00d7d7
COLOR_DEVICE=#d7d700
COLOR_EXEC=#00d700
COLOR_ACCENT=#00d7d7
ll=ls -la
la=ls -la
mydev=ls -la dev
check=probe rfc2305 --node self

bin._notes: Software Bank tools resolve here via Console.gd's usr/bin fallthrough, per docs/systems/console-commands.md -- not hardcoded match cases. spec/probe are universal (every technician has basic diagnostic tools); claim is Scrapshell's own root command (os-lineages.md section 3's quorum model) -- Earthstock's usr/bin ships elevate instead, not both gated by a flag.
